svg.aria-label: lockhttp: Claude Code, in a lea container, reads a page of pkg.go.dev, a trusted host, and the gate lets it through at once. It then POSTs a build report to hooks.example.net, an unknown host: the gate holds it, and the lockhttp console, in its own account, shows the approval screen with the body masked. The human answers n token in body; the agent gets a 403 E_DENIED, and the gate's audit records both decisions.
